title: Multischema mux: decoder regression and streaming checkpoint validation suite
creator: Evan Chen
description: Create an automated regression and smoke test suite that validates JSON mode enforcement and constrained-decoder behavior when a single request may negotiate different schema versions or switch schema mid-stream due to tool/function calls. The suite must cover: (1) streaming partial JSON that must be reassembled and validated at checkpoints, (2) tool-return payloads that introduce a different schema version and trigger dynamic schema selection, (3) constrained decoding enforcement under token-level penalties and sampling noise, and (4) compatibility fallbacks where the runtime substitutes a compatible schema adapter. Tests should run in CI against the latest decoder and the compatibility shim. Acceptance criteria: deterministic pass/fail for defined cases, clear failure classifications (decoder, schema-mapper, assembler, or tooling), and a small reproduction harness for local dev that can replay failing streams.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end CI job that runs the suite against runtime-1.31 and reports pass/fail status
Coverage: partial-stream reassembly, mid-stream schema swap, tool-call injected schema, and decoder backoff behavior
Failure classifications must map to one of: decoder, schema-mapper, assembler, tooling
Local replay harness with recorded token streams and expected JSON artifacts
Tests are stable within known nondeterminism bounds; flaky tests documented and quarantined
steps: Design test vectors: 12 scenarios including nested toolcalls and schema downgrade/upgrade cases
Implement stream replayer and checkpoint validator (node/python harness)
Integrate with existing constrained-decoder test harness and add multischema mapping layer
Create CI job with matrix: deterministic-decoder vs sampling-decoder; streaming vs non-streaming
Run baseline and document failures; triage into follow-ups
